name: diag_t02_cache_remaining70_plan_01
command:
import json,hashlib,shlex
from pathlib import Path
from src.tools.t01_partition import audited_result
root=Path.cwd().resolve()
report_path=Path("logs/review/diag_test_selected05_final_export_inventory_02/report.json")
body=report_path.read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()=="040aee310ae817ba923706546a8d0de0de5c565683fc9752c9d332cc79394c7c"
inventory=json.loads(body)
cache,cache_ref=audited_result("results/t02_export_cache_test_selected05_first6_01.json")
first=list(cache["config"]["source"]);all_sources=list(inventory["successful_source_files"])
assert len(first)==6 and all_sources[:6]==first and len(all_sources)==76
remaining=[s for s in all_sources if s not in set(first)]
assert len(remaining)==70 and len(set(remaining))==70
by_file={x["source"]["file"]:x for x in inventory["outcomes"]}
batches=[]
for i in range(0,len(remaining),6):
 files=remaining[i:i+6];number=i//6+1
 name="t02_export_cache_test_selected05_remaining_b%02d"%number
 wrapper="diag_submit_"+name
 assert not (root/"results"/(name+".json")).exists()
 members=[]
 for f in files:
  r=by_file[f];raw=(root/f).read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==r["source"]["sha256"]
  assert r["status"]=="exported" and r["export_checks_complete"] is True
  members.append({k:r[k] for k in ("source","pair_id","scene","kind","pair_reference","configuration_id","table_manifest")})
 command=["python3","-u","-m","src.tools.t02_cache_check","--name",name]
 for f in files:command+=["--source",f]
 command+=["--sample-size","200","--seed","0","--timeout-seconds","1200","--pair-timeout-seconds","180","--gate-timeout-seconds","180"]
 submit=["python3","scripts/run_logged.py","--name",wrapper,"--seed","0","--","python3","-m","src.tools.record_command","--name",wrapper,"--","python3","scripts/pbs/submit_phase.py","--name",name,"--task","T01","--budget-group","T02","--gpus","1","--walltime","00:20:30","--",*command]
 batches.append({"batch":number,"name":name,"sources":members,"checker_command":command,"submit_command":submit,"submit_shell":shlex.join(submit),"submitted":False})
report={"scope":"Operational continuation plan only, using the unchanged original T02 checker; prepared but not submitted. Original 95 candidate denominator and all19 export errors remain intact. The failed first6 cache attempt remains intact: its one mismatched pair is not relabelled, and its other five sources remain untested. This manifest covers only the other70 exported sources in the original stable order; no scientific acceptance, source exclusion from original ledger, resampling of first6, or pool freeze.","inventory":{"file":str(report_path),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()},"first6_cache_source":cache_ref,"first6_excluded_from_this_new_work_queue_only":first,"source_order":"successful_source_files from sealed selected05 inventory, preserving original ordering","remaining_source_count":len(remaining),"batches":batches}
out=Path("logs/review/diag_t02_cache_remaining70_plan_01/report.json");out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);out.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+"\n")
print(json.dumps({"report":{"file":str(out),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest()},"remaining_source_count":len(remaining),"batch_sizes":[len(x["sources"]) for x in batches],"next_command":batches[0]["submit_shell"],"submitted":False},sort_keys=True))
